evaluation.rationale: The notes capture almost all the important information from the transcript, but suffer from severe repetition, bloating the text significantly. The same facts are repeated across Overview, Summary, Account Context, Pain Points, Buying Signals, Objections, Budget/Timeline, Follow-up email, and the structured blocks. There are also several contradictions: the notes correctly identify the Zendesk plan but then list it as an open question, and they assign the NDA action item to both Priya and Jon. Additionally, superseded values (October 15 go-live, Dec 31 contract end) are incorrectly listed as inferred action items, and there is a date typo (May 29 instead of April 29) and a speaker misattribution ('Speaker 1 (me)').
